title: Ankhorage Templates
summary: Provides portable application templates, design presets, manifest authoring helpers, and a reusable template catalog.
purpose: Turn reusable template definitions and presets into validated project seeds without coupling them to one authoring application.
responsibilities: Publish template manifests, presets, design categories, and catalog selection behavior.
Validate and compose portable manifests and project seeds.
Expose template authoring through package, CLI, and capability entrypoints.
Generate and consume the repository-owned template catalog.
boundaries: Does not own rendering primitives, runtime execution, or navigation behavior.
Does not deploy generated applications or manage their repositories.
Does not make template consumers depend on a sibling Studio checkout.
audience: Application generators and authoring tools selecting reusable templates.
Developers composing validated manifests and project seeds.
useCases: Select a template from the published catalog.
Compose a validated manifest shell with category design presets.
Materialize a portable project seed for downstream generation.

architecture.role: Reusable template and manifest-authoring library with a thin CLI and capability boundary.
invariants: Runtime, navigation, design-system, and color behavior are consumed through published public APIs.
Generated catalog data remains owned by the template catalog workflow.

limitations: A template only includes assets and capabilities declared by its manifest.
Final application generation and deployment are performed by downstream consumers.
